T: For England, James. And for dinner.
D: Bond races to stop a former friend from using a stolen Soviet satellite weapon.
P: Serve the drinks when Bond orders his vodka martini at the casino in Monte Carlo.
S: the Russian gangster with the caviar business
Buckwheat blini cooked small in butter, topped with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, served on ice beside a bottle of frozen vodka.
the baccarat table in Monte Carlo
Socca chickpea pancakes cut into wedges with tapenade, and anchovy and olive pissaladière squares on puff pastry.
the tank chase through St Petersburg
Soft yeasted buns filled with beef mince, onion and dill, baked at 200C for 18 minutes, brushed with butter.
M: a Russian supper after the snow
Beef fillet strips seared fast, mushrooms and onion cooked in butter, paprika, a splash of brandy, stock and sour cream, over buttered egg noodles.
the satellite dish hidden in Cuba
Pork shoulder marinated in sour orange, garlic and cumin, roasted at 160C for 4 hours, with black beans and rice and fried plantain.
W: Little golden Russian cottage cheese pancakes with sour cream and berry jam. Mix 500g cottage cheese, 2 eggs, 3 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and 80g flour.
K: 60ml vodka and 10ml dry vermouth shaken hard with ice, strained into a chilled glass, lemon peel.

s.note: the Russian gangster with the caviar business
s.how: Mix 150g buckwheat flour, 7g yeast and 250ml warm milk and rest an hour. Cook small spoonfuls in butter until golden. Top each with crème fraîche, salmon roe and snipped chives. Serve beside frozen vodka.

s.note: the tank chase through St Petersburg
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 30g butter into a soft dough and prove an hour. Fry 400g beef mince with an onion and dill and cool. Fill 12 rounds, seal and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Brush with butter.

m.note: a Russian supper after the snow
m.how: Sear 600g beef fillet strips fast and set aside. Cook 300g mushrooms and an onion in 30g butter, add 1 tsp paprika and flame 30ml brandy. Add 200ml stock, then stir in 200g sour cream off the heat and return the beef. Serve over 400g buttered egg noodles.

w.how: Mix 500g cottage cheese, 2 eggs, 3 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and 80g flour. Shape 12 small patties, dust in flour and fry in butter for 3 minutes a side. Serve with 150g sour cream and berry jam.

d.how: For each drink, shake 60ml vodka and 10ml dry vermouth hard with ice. Strain into a chilled martini glass and twist a strip of lemon peel over the top. Makes four.
